title: Merge version 3.1.2-2 from Debian. This version will allow us to drop a couple of patches because they were applied upstream.
description:
Merge version 3.1.2-2 from Debian. This version will allow us to drop a couple of patches because they were applied upstream.

PPA with the proposed changes:

https://launchpad.net/~lucaskanashiro/+archive/ubuntu/ha-stack/+packages

autopkgtest is still happy:

autopkgtest [16:47:56]: @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ summary
cfgtool              PASS
quorumtool           PASS

diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 10ddf0a..4942e45 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,26 @@
+corosync (3.1.2-2ubuntu1) impish; urgency=medium
+
+  * Merge with Debian unstable. Remaining changes:
+    - d/t/control: add allow-stderr restriction
+    - d/control: corosync binary depends on libqb-dev
+      (LP #1677684)
+    - Retry knet_handle_new without privileged flag (LP #1918735)
+      + d/p/lp1918735/0001-allow_knet_handle_fallback_default_yes.patch
+    - d/p/Make-the-example-config-valid.patch: comment out the node name in
+      config file
+      + With this, we will keep the same behavior as we have in Bionic which is
+        using the output of "uname -n" as the node name (LP #1874719).
+    - d/t/quorumtool: search for localhost instead of node1
+  * Dropped:
+    - d/p/lp1911904-Don-t-lock-all-current-and-future-memory-if-can-t-in.patch:
+      + Don't mlockall() if setrlimit() fails (LP #1911904)
+      [Applied by upstream in version 3.1.1]
+    - Retry knet_handle_new without privileged flag (LP #1918735)
+      + d/p/lp1918735/0001-try-unprivileged-knet-handle-new.patch
+      [Applied by upstream in version 3.1.1]
+
+ -- Lucas Kanashiro <kanashiro@ubuntu.com>  Fri, 23 Jul 2021 16:27:47 -0300
+

@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+From: Dan Streetman <ddstreet@canonical.com>
+Origin: vendor
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/corosync/+bug/1918735
+
+Set allow_knet_handle_fallback to yes in example conf file. This setting is
+required for transport=knet (which is the default) to work in an unprivileged
+container.
+
+--- a/conf/corosync.conf.example
++++ b/conf/corosync.conf.example
+@@ -1,4 +1,10 @@
+ # Please read the corosync.conf.5 manual page
++system {
++	# This is required to use transport=knet in an unprivileged
++	# environment, such as a container. See man page for details.
++	allow_knet_handle_fallback: yes
++}
++
+ totem {
+ 	version: 2
+
